# Dex AI

This is a living code repository. As the agent and human work together on this project, this memory file and all its contents will be continuously updated. For coding agent, update this memory whenever you learn new details about the project.

## Agent Docs Index (docs/agent-docs)
Format:
```
[Memory title](location) - description
```
You can add more as the knowledge of project expands.

- Tech Stack (not exist, update location and description when do)
- Conventions (not exist, update location and description when do)

## Other documents generated by agent
All these folders follow format of `<YYMMDD>-<slug>/`
- Feature specs: `docs/agent-docs/specs/`
- Implementation plans: `docs/agent-docs/plans/`
- Research: `docs/agent-docs/research/`.
